bib.title: Pandora's Box or Aladdin's Lamp: A Comprehensive Analysis Revealing the Role of RAG Noise in Large Language Models

read.skipped: Reference list skimmed; case-study tables 14-17 only skimmed

question: Is noise in retrieved documents always harmful to RAG generators, and which noise types help or hurt?
hypothesis: Some linguistically defined noise types (semantic, datatype, illegal sentence) are beneficial and improve accuracy over golden-context-only RAG; others (counterfactual, supportive, orthographic, prior) are harmful.
contributions: Define seven noise types and group them into beneficial and harmful
Framework for constructing noisy retrieval documents and the NoiserBench benchmark
Evaluation on multiple datasets and eight LLMs showing beneficial noise can raise accuracy
Analysis of mechanisms (clearer reasoning, standard format, more confidence in gold context)

method.summary: Builds NoiserBench: QA items from eight datasets turned into 4-option multiple choice, with golden evidence plus synthetic noise documents of seven types (gold placed in the middle of a 5-doc list). Eight off-the-shelf LLMs are evaluated zero-shot under Base, Golden Only, and Golden plus each noise type.
method.task: Retrieval-augmented multiple-choice QA under noisy context

inference.samples: inferred: one run per condition; no seeds or repeats reported
inference.prompting: Zero-shot; 4 options (correct, two counterfactual alternatives, 'Uncertain'), golden option position randomised; answer then explanation format
inference.retrieval: Top-k=5 Contriever, all-MiniLM-L6-v2 similarity threshold 0.3, dot product similarity; 2018 English Wikipedia dump; gold document placed in the middle of the list

parameters.DN: ChatGPT inserts URLs or code keeping the answer

other.Golden Only: only the gold passage, no other documents

metrics.name: accuracy
metrics.definition: Fraction of multiple-choice answers correct; PriorQA counts answering 'The question is factually incorrect'; weighted average across datasets

eval.protocol: Wilcoxon signed-rank test, alpha 0.05, on with vs without beneficial noise; 100-sample manual checks for reasoning and format; 500 sampled per dataset

limits: Authors concede the mechanism analysis is preliminary (attention values by layer left to future work) and task domains are limited
Decoding settings, temperature and seeds are not reported; single run per cell, no confidence intervals except Wilcoxon p

Gain is over Golden Only, a single gold passage; noise docs are synthetic (random vocabulary words, URL insertions) and the gold doc is always present, so it does not show that arbitrary real retrieved distractors help
Multiple-choice format with an 'Uncertain' option may favour more formatted outputs; effect sizes are often under 1-3 points and many individual cells fall below Golden Only
Large RGB average gains are driven by Llama2-13B (29.33 to 72.33 with ISN)
Noise-ratio table caption says ISN ratios while the text says orthographic noise ratios
Same RGB row differs between Table 3 and Table 8 (79.71 vs 79.63)

noise (counterfactual, supportive, orthographic, prior) that impairs performance
